urlText: Chatswood Station Lift 1 between the concourse and Platform 3/4 is not available
content:
At Chatswood Station Lift 1 between the concourse and Platform 3/4 is temporarily out of service.
This lift will be undergoing an upgrade from Thursday 29 May until Friday 6 June 2025.
If you are travelling from Chatswood Platforms 3 or 4 and need lift access, take a train from Platform 1 to Artarmon and change for a train towards Hornsby. Or take a metro service from Platform 2 to Crows Nest and change for a metro service towards Tallawong.
If you are arriving at Chatswood Platforms 3 or 4 and need lift access, remain on the train to Lindfield and change for a train towards Central arriving at Chatswood Platform 1. Or remain on the metro service to North Ryde and change for a metro service towards Sydenham arriving on Platform 2.

If you need help, ask staff or phone 02 9379 3311.
subtitle: Chatswood Station Lift 1 between the concourse and Platform 3/4 is not available

urlText: L1 Fish Market lift out of service
content:
The lift at the Fish Market light rail stop on the L1 Dulwich Hill Line is temporarily out of service until further notice.
For your safety, do not use even if doors open.
Alternative access:
  • Use the stairs, if able to
  • Or use the opposite accessible entry/exit ramp via Bank Street.
For urgent assistance:
  • Use the Help Point if on the platform
  • Or call 131 500
subtitle: L1 Fish Market lift out of service
